payload.body:
Guild listing: SYNTAX. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text, supplied by the Founder.

Leader: @[SYN] Electric5heep 

A Decentralized Autonomous Corporation (DAC) in the Star Atlas Metaverse focusing on Data Running / Stealth / Private Contracts / Exploration.

Our goal is twofold; First, to provide a stable home and like-minded community for those looking for a structured guild with leadership to support new players. Second, to acquire a strong reputation within the metaverse through critical alliances and profitability by having Data Running at the forefront of our activities.

Discord link: https://discord.gg/tGVfKESSZq
